comments.reason: Comment and reply rows arrive through the ensemble and reddit routes together with posts, so a per route window row cannot separate them.

creators.reason: No connector key collects creators alone; creator channel uploads arrive through the youtube route together with search and trending videos.

events.reason: No connector key in the run registry collects events.

phrases.reason: No connector key in the run registry collects phrases.

unseeded_discovery.reason: Unseeded discovery lives in signal candidates, not in collected raw rows.

unassigned_routes.youtube: The run maps youtube to its own youtube channel family, which is none of the product families.
unassigned_routes.youtube_scrape: The run maps youtube_scrape to its own youtube channel family, which is none of the product families.
unassigned_routes.wikipedia: The run maps wikipedia to its own wikipedia channel family, which is none of the product families.
unassigned_routes.cloudflare_radar: The run maps cloudflare_radar to its own web_attention channel family, which is none of the product families.
